issues.description: The problem description uses a snake_case identifier `get_total_number_of_students()` (problem_statement.md lines 40-41) while the UML, template TODOs, and the solution use the camelCase name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This inconsistent naming for the same method can confuse students about the exact method name they should implement and how it will be referenced in tests or examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent method name across all artifacts. Update the problem statement to refer to getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase) to match the UML, template TODOs, and solution. Alternatively, explicitly note in the problem text that get_total_number_of_students() refers to the camelCase method getTotalNumberOfStudents().
